text:
jamie: Noticing a jump in /v1/embeddings 503s in eu-west1 since 09:07 UTC. Rooted to nodes running embed-runtime v2.2.7. I have a hotfix that pins runtime to v2.3.1 which fixes a kv-cache eviction race. Requesting expedited push to Dedicated eu pool, canary bypass.
rohan: How risky is skipping canary? can we at least do a tiny 1-node canary (5m) before full roll?
sasha: Telemetry: error-rate up to 3% in affected shard, 95th latency +1.8x. Patch built from main @ abc123, smoke + integration tests green in staging. Bypass acceptable if ops + oncall approve and rollback steps are documented.
jamie: Artifact: gs://redwood-builds/embeddings/abc123.tar.gz. Release note snippet: "Fix: kv-cache eviction race causing intermittent 503s for embeddings."
rohan: @deploybot run preflight and list blockers.
deploybot: Preflight results -> smoke: PASS; canary-tests: SKIPPED (expedite requested); migrations: none; open-release-PRs: 0; config-drift: none. Requires interactive approvals: ops + product. React :thumbsup: within 10m to approve.
tess: Oncall here. I'm +1 if rollback is a single-command fallback. Need rollback command pasted in thread.
sasha: Ops-tested rollback commands below (worked in staging):
```
./scripts/rollback-embed.sh --cluster=eu-west1 --tag=v2.3.0 --grace-period=30
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/embed-service embed=redwood/embed:v2.3.0
```
This cleans KV and restores previous image.
rohan: :thumbsup: (ops)
jamie: Product (tess) confirmed in DM: "impact > SLO, OK to expedite with rollback guardrails" — posting here for audit.
jamie: Approved. Triggering deploy now. Deploy ID: deploy_1742223344_hotfix_pin. Rolling 6 nodes, sequential.
deploybot: Deploy triggered by jamie. Canary bypass honored. Progress: 0/6 failed, 3/6 updated, 6/6 updated. Post-deploy smoke: PASS.
deploybot: Traffic shifted to v2.3.1 (100%). Monitoring window: 15m.
jamie: Monitor dashboards: embeds-errors, embed-latency, redis-ejects. If errors >1% or 95th latency >2x baseline execute rollback above and ping #incidents.
sasha: +7m: metrics stable, error-rate back to baseline. No obvious regressions.
jamie: I'll update release notes, tag changelog, and notify support to annotate related tickets. Thanks all for fast turnaround :rocket:
